The staking figures are discussed as tokenomics information with stated lock-up periods, without framing them as guaranteed future returns or clearly soliciting viewers to stake. An educational disclaimer and ordinary exchange referral link provide context for the promotional elements, with no described deceptive conditions, required payment, credential collection, victim loss, or promised investment result.
